title: Eleven Minutes Down to the Water
subtitle: 传统节日 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 传统节日（历史与文化·传统节日与习俗）
meta: 主题语境：传统节日（历史与文化·传统节日与习俗）　|　核心词汇：tradition　|　正文 362 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tradition 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① tradition in our house was that nobody spoke between the pudding and the walk, and this was not a rule anybody had written down and not a rule anybody could explain; it simply was, and for thirty-one years it held, and no tradition survives being explained. My grandmother called it a ② tradition of the village, which my father said it was not, and he was right, and it did not matter.

③ By tradition the walk went the same way every year: eleven minutes down to the water and eleven minutes back, and nobody was allowed to go faster and nobody was allowed to go slower, and my grandfather set the pace from the front and never once turned round. There is a ④ long tradition in that county of walking after dinner, and it is not a health thing and it is not a religious thing, and no visitor has ever understood it.

In 1979 my sister ⑤ broke with tradition by speaking, at the pudding, at the age of eleven, and the walk was cancelled, and everybody sat in the dark for an hour. She said afterwards that she had only asked a question. My grandmother's silence was ⑥ in the tradition of her mother's, which was said to have lasted eleven years after 1931 and which nobody in the family has ever explained.

⑦ Tradition has it that the walk began in 1801, when a man in the village walked to the water and back every night for eleven weeks because his daughter was ill, and that it cured nobody and kept eleven people sane. My grandmother knew the ⑧ tradition of it better than anybody, meaning the eleven songs you were supposed to sing on the way down, and she knew nine of them and made up the other two.

The ⑨ tradition ended in 1998, when my grandfather died and the house was sold, and the tradition was thirty-one years old and died with him. The ⑩ traditions I keep, and I keep two, are the pudding and the silence, and my daughter says the silence is the worse of the two, and I say the silence is the one that does the work.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 传统；惯例；老规矩
B. n. 传统习俗；风俗
C. n. 世代相传的做法；传统技艺
D. 固定搭配：by tradition 按照传统；依惯例
E. 固定搭配：in the tradition of ... 承……的传统／风格
F. 固定搭配：break with tradition 打破传统；破例
G. 固定搭配：a long tradition of ... ……的悠久传统
H. 固定搭配：tradition has it that ... 据传统说法／相传……

items.q: The tradition in our house was that nobody
My grandmother called it a tradition of the village
By tradition the walk went the same way
There is a long tradition in that county
my sister broke with tradition by speaking
in the tradition of her mother's
Tradition has it that the walk began
knew the tradition of it better than anybody
The traditions I keep, and I keep two

answers.why: the tradition 意为“老规矩、惯例”，我家的规矩是布丁上桌到出门散步之间谁也不许说话。
a tradition of the village 意为“村里的传统习俗”，祖母说这是村里的风俗，父亲说不是。
by tradition 意为“按照传统、依惯例”，依照惯例，每年散步走同一条路。
a long tradition of ... 意为“……的悠久传统”，那个郡有饭后散步的悠久传统。
break with tradition 意为“打破传统、破例”，1979 年我妹妹十一岁，在布丁桌上开口说话，破了例。
in the tradition of ... 意为“承……的传统、风格”，祖母的沉默承自她母亲。
tradition has it that ... 意为“相传、据传统说法……”，相传这个散步始于 1801 年。
the tradition of it 意为“世代相传的做法、老一套的技艺”，祖母最懂其中的门道：下坡时该唱的那十一首歌。
the tradition 意为“这个惯例、老规矩”，1998 年祖父去世、房子卖掉，这个规矩也就完了。
traditions 意为“传统习俗”，我保留下来的习俗有两个：布丁和沉默。

answers: The tradition in our house was that nobody spoke between the pudding and the walk, and it held for thirty-one years.
